title: vaporvee's Vanilla Ultra
description: Yet another vanilla plus pack but this time with all the client mods i actually need (other packs are more like vanilla plus minus 0)
body:
# 🌿 vaporvee's Vanilla Ultra  

**vaporvee's Vanilla Ultra** is a simple **vanilla+ pack** that puts together just about every client-side mod I could find.  
The goal is to keep the game close to vanilla while improving **performance, visuals, UI, and immersion**.  

---

## 🔧 Features  

### ⚡ Performance  
- 🧩 Sodium, FerriteCore, MoreCulling, BadOptimizations  
- 🌄 Distant Horizons for extended render distance  

### 🎨 Visuals  
- 🐾 Fresh Animations  
- 👾 Revamped mob textures (creepers, skeletons, zombies, endermen, etc.)  
- 🌱 Bushier Bushes, Fancy Crops, Grass Flowers  
- 🛡 Clearer UI: armor/status bars, slot highlights  
- 🔦 Dynamic Lights  

### 🎶 Audio & Immersion  
- 🌌 Ambient Sounds  
- 🔊 Sound Physics Remastered  
- 👣 Presence Footsteps  
- 💨 Particle tweaks (rain, subtle effects, extra particles)  

### 🏗 Building & Technical Tools  
- 📐 Litematica + Malilib  
- 🧱 Axiom  
- 🎮 Controlify (controller support)  
- ⏪ Flashback (world snapshots)  
- 📝 Scribble (in-game notes)  

### 🖥 UI & QoL  
- 🖱 Mouse Tweaks, Controlling, Searchables  
- ⚡ One-Click Join  
- 🧼 Cleaner Menus, SmoothUI  
- 📊 Scoreboard and HUD overhauls  

---

## 🎒 Resourcepacks  

- 🐉 Fresh Animations  
- 👾 Mob revamps (Creepers, Skeletons, Endermen, Illagers, Blazes, Zombies, etc.)  
- 🔠 Capitalized fonts  
- 🔥 Torch/eating animations  
- ✨ Enchantment outlines & custom icons  
- 🌱 Small environmental tweaks (plants, crops, bushes)  

---

## 📌 Summary  

If you want vanilla Minecraft but with:  
- ⚡ smoother performance  
- 🎨 better visuals and sounds  
- 🛠 loads of client-side QoL  

then this pack does the job. Nothing fancy, just **vanilla, but upgraded**.
